prompt: A warm painted animated film in the same elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous locked-off medium shot. Preserve the characters, faces, adult proportions, clothing, warm lighting, painted texture and fixed kitchen from the reference. Natural restrained human motion at normal speed. Stable solid objects with clearly separated hands and surfaces. The chef and silver-haired restaurant owner review the open roster together. The chef indicates a row on the paper with her fingertip, then looks toward the owner. He looks at the same row, gives a small thoughtful nod, and meets her glance. Their hands remain supported on the wooden bench or touching the paper. A calm natural exchange, subtle facial expressions and breathing.
